methodology: Execute 12 representative tasks, measure file relevance

tasks.title: Add 'braxis score' command
tasks.description: Add a new subcommand 'braxis score' that displays the AI readiness score for the current project
requirements: Add new command to CLI interface
Implement scoring logic that calls existing analysis
Add help text: 'Display AI readiness score'
success_criteria: Command exists and shows help text

tasks.title: Add 'braxis validate' command
tasks.description: Add subcommand to validate Braxis limitations against actual codebase metrics
requirements: Exit code: 0 if valid, 1 if gaps found

tasks.title: Add 'braxis benchmark' command
tasks.description: Add command to run security scanning benchmark against test cases

tasks.title: Add 'braxis template' command
tasks.description: Add command to generate template-based context (for A/B testing)

tasks.title: Fix: Complexity detection missing FastAPI custom wrappers
tasks.description: Braxis doesn't detect FastAPI when used via internal wrapper (e.g., 'from my_fastapi_wrapper import FastAPI'). Add detection for indirect imports.
success_criteria: Test case added for this pattern

tasks.title: Fix: Confidence level display formatting
tasks.description: When displaying confidence levels (e.g., '72%'), sometimes formatting is inconsistent. Ensure all confidence metrics use 2 decimal places.
success_criteria: All confidence output uses consistent format

tasks.title: Fix: Context relevance score inconsistency
tasks.description: Context relevance score sometimes ranges 0-1, sometimes 0-100. Standardize to 0-1 scale throughout.

tasks.title: Add tests for complexity formula edge cases
tasks.description: Add test cases for complexity estimation with edge cases: 0 files, extremely large repos, monorepos

tasks.title: Add tests for security scanning accuracy
tasks.description: Add unit tests to verify security scanning finds expected vulnerabilities in test cases
requirements: Each with positive and negative cases

tasks.title: Add tests for context relevance correlation
tasks.description: Add tests verifying context relevance score correlates with agent task success

tasks.title: Extract complexity calculation into separate module
tasks.description: Move complexity estimation logic from braxis.py into dedicated complexity.py module for better organization and testability
requirements: Update imports in braxis.py and tests

tasks.title: Extract security scanning into separate module
tasks.description: Move security scanning logic from braxis.py into security.py module

tasks.title: Add input validation to repo path parameter
tasks.description: Ensure repo_path parameter is validated before analysis: must exist, must be readable, must not be outside current user's home dir
requirements: Raise clear error on invalid path

tasks.title: Sanitize file paths in output
tasks.description: When displaying file paths in analysis output, ensure no sensitive paths are exposed
requirements: Replace absolute paths with relative paths
